E1_item3_exact.text: f is an upward parabola in M with f(0) = -q r < 0, so its positive root M is below F iff f(F) > 0; f(F) = F^2 a^2 > 0 for every dt > 0. Hence M < F exactly, and the L* bound follows by the recorded sign argument.

E1_item3_recorded.text: Each printed example has M = F to the printed digits; with a^2 below 1e-50 the difference F - M = O(F a^2) is below the 50-digit working precision. Attribution: code (precision).
